matrix_rule: Every entry has an explicit type and evidence class. No metaphor, equation, source file, test file, local verifier, literature result, or proposed experiment may be cast into an implementation, physical device, electrical mapping, causal mechanism, cognitive construct, safety result, product capability, license, canon admission, or disclosure authority.

entries.statement: An ideal charge-controlled electrical memristor is a typed charge-flux constitutive element with electrical dimensions.
entries.allowed_wording: Classical circuit theory defines an ideal electrical memristor.
entries.prohibited_inference: CAS charge, flux, voltage, current, memristance, physical telemetry, or device.
entries.closure_obligation: Any future use must preserve electrical units and the exact constitutive hypotheses.

entries.statement: A generalized memristive system is an electrical state system and is not definitionally identical to the ideal charge-flux element.
entries.allowed_wording: Generalized electrical memristive-system theory motivates explicit state and history questions.
entries.prohibited_inference: Every history-dependent model is electrical or memristive.
entries.closure_obligation: Preserve the electrical state, input, response, and dimensional assumptions.

entries.statement: A conceptual metaphor is a documented comparison without a type-preserving mathematical, executable, or physical map.
entries.allowed_wording: The memristor metaphor motivates a research question.
entries.prohibited_inference: The metaphor proves dynamics, implementation, materiality, cognition, causality, or benefit.
entries.closure_obligation: Keep every metaphor explicitly labelled and non-normative.

entries.statement: A mathematical history-state model declares state, input, context, injection, response, update, observation, timebase, reset, and parameter objects.
entries.allowed_wording: This draft proposes a typed nonphysical history-state model.
entries.prohibited_inference: The model is identified, implemented, validated, cognitive, causal, safe, or physical.
entries.closure_obligation: Obtain formal review of domains, update order, reset, timing, uncertainty, and identifiability.

entries.statement: A software implementation requires exact executable, dependency, environment, model, data, test, and conformance identities.
entries.allowed_wording: Implementation is a separate evidence-bearing type.
entries.prohibited_inference: Source presence or a local test proves a conforming implementation.
entries.closure_obligation: Create and independently verify a successor implementation/conformance specification before any implementation claim.

entries.statement: A physical device requires material, fabrication, terminal, instrumentation, environment, calibration, uncertainty, and device-provenance evidence.
entries.allowed_wording: Physical-device evidence is a separate type and is absent here.
entries.prohibited_inference: A software loop, scalar state, equation, or source label is a fabricated device.
entries.closure_obligation: Require separately authorized device-physics evidence and qualified review.

entries.statement: An experimental result requires a joined authorized run, admitted evidence, independent replay, replication, and scoped claim review.
entries.allowed_wording: No experimental result is present.
entries.prohibited_inference: The draft or source inventory is an experiment.
entries.closure_obligation: Close the exact Gate 5 scientific criteria for a separately authorized claim.

entries.statement: Context is a frozen typed record of task, prompt, model, layer, token, environment, time, and group fields available under declared timing.
entries.allowed_wording: The proposal defines a typed context record.
entries.prohibited_inference: Context means consciousness, intent, or an unlogged analyst judgment.
entries.closure_obligation: Freeze schemas, missingness, provenance, availability timing, and context strata.

entries.statement: Memory state is a versioned mathematical state record with explicit initialization, update, timebase, reset, drift, uncertainty, and provenance.
entries.allowed_wording: A future profile must declare an explicit memory state.
entries.prohibited_inference: Caches, hidden sessions, RNG state, or drift are admitted memory.
entries.closure_obligation: Specify and audit the complete state lifecycle.

entries.statement: Injection is a bound mathematical addition at a declared layer, token rule, direction, coefficient, and time.
entries.allowed_wording: Primary steering literature motivates a typed activation-addition operator.
entries.prohibited_inference: Prompt-injection defense, electrical current, concept identity, causal effect, or live capability.
entries.closure_obligation: Bind the direction construction, norm, layer, token rule, timing, and controls.

entries.statement: Steering is the full preregistered injection and control schedule, not a result or semantic interpretation.
entries.allowed_wording: A future study may randomize a steering schedule.
entries.prohibited_inference: Steering is effective, safe, causal, or product-ready.
entries.closure_obligation: Preregister all schedules, nulls, matched directions, ordering, and falsifiers.

entries.statement: Path dependence requires different admitted histories with matched present input, context, and injection to yield a preregistered response difference.
entries.allowed_wording: The proposal supplies a falsifiable path-dependence criterion.
entries.prohibited_inference: Path dependence has been observed or establishes physical/cognitive memory.
entries.closure_obligation: Freeze matching tolerances, uncertainty, sequence units, reset, drift, and order controls.

entries.statement: Hysteresis is a restricted path-dependent response under a preregistered cyclic or reversal schedule with repeated-cycle, reset, drift, delay, and saturation controls.
entries.allowed_wording: A future study could test a qualified loop statistic.
entries.prohibited_inference: A looped plot alone proves hysteresis or a memristor.
entries.closure_obligation: Obtain hysteresis-specialist review and distinguish lag, drift, clipping, and plotting artifacts.

entries.statement: Classical gliding-box lacunarity is a scale-indexed ratio of the second mass moment to squared first mass moment under a declared box and mass process.
entries.allowed_wording: Classical lacunarity is multiscale and domain-dependent.
entries.prohibited_inference: Every repository quantity called lacunarity is this statistic.
entries.closure_obligation: Bind mass, scale, boxes, boundary handling, zeros, and sampling.

entries.statement: History lacunarity is a proposed scale-indexed statistic over a frozen history-event mass ontology.
entries.allowed_wording: The proposal defines a candidate history-lacunarity diagnostic.
entries.prohibited_inference: It measures cognitive gaps or adds predictive value.
entries.closure_obligation: Compare against variance, CV, entropy, sparsity, occupancy, length, and category coverage.

entries.statement: The strict memoryless baseline uses the same present-time information and matched capacity and training conditions without recursive state or prior sequence access.
entries.allowed_wording: A stateful claim requires comparison against a matched strict memoryless baseline.
entries.prohibited_inference: An underpowered or information-deprived baseline is a fair match.
entries.closure_obligation: Predeclare feature, capacity, split, training, compute, regularization, and stopping matches.

entries.statement: For nonzero mean mass, E[M^2]/E[M]^2 equals 1 plus Var(M)/E[M]^2.
entries.allowed_wording: Variance over mean squared is Lambda minus one under the same declared mass distribution.
entries.prohibited_inference: Any repository vector is automatically a box-mass distribution or multiscale lacunarity.
entries.closure_obligation: Have a lacunarity specialist verify notation and use.

entries.statement: If the prediction ignores state and prior history, the declared profile collapses to the strict memoryless form for the bound inputs.
entries.allowed_wording: The baseline is definitionally memoryless within the declared feature set.
entries.prohibited_inference: The data-generating process has no memory.
entries.closure_obligation: Audit hidden feature and runtime history access.

entries.statement: This supplemental draft asserts no new theorem and changes no shared theorem status.
entries.allowed_wording: The draft contains definitions, standard algebra, and hypotheses only.
entries.prohibited_inference: A proposed state equation or source citation is an admitted CAS theorem.
entries.closure_obligation: Route any later theorem claim through the shared theorem registry.

entries.statement: The exact Wave 1 engineering package records the memristive extension as open and nonphysical.
entries.allowed_wording: This supplement elaborates an existing open Wave 1 obligation.
entries.prohibited_inference: Wave 1 authorized or completed the extension.
entries.closure_obligation: Preserve all Wave 1 limitations during integration.

entries.allowed_wording: Gate 4 remains open and supplies constraints.
entries.prohibited_inference: Gate 4 is closed or this supplement changes a criterion.
entries.closure_obligation: Re-run the authoritative verifier at integration.

entries.allowed_wording: Gate 5 supplies future evidence-control requirements.
entries.prohibited_inference: An experiment or admitted packet exists for this supplement.
entries.closure_obligation: Keep every scientific and authority criterion open until exact closure evidence exists.

entries.prohibited_inference: The code executed, is correct, is classical lacunarity, or measures cognition.

entries.closure_obligation: Submit any future claim or symbol through the appropriate shared governance process.

entries.statement: A frozen history-state profile may improve grouped held-out prediction over a matched strict memoryless baseline.
entries.allowed_wording: This is a falsifiable preregistration candidate.
entries.prohibited_inference: Prediction has improved or memory is established.
entries.closure_obligation: Execute authorized grouped holdout with leakage, capacity, uncertainty, and falsifier controls.

entries.statement: A frozen history-state profile may add held-out value beyond a capacity-matched explicit finite history window.
entries.allowed_wording: This distinguishes recursive state from access to recent observations.
entries.prohibited_inference: Latent state is necessary or identifiable.
entries.closure_obligation: Predeclare the window, capacity match, and grouped evaluation.

entries.statement: Matched present conditions following different randomized history orders may yield a reproducible response difference.
entries.allowed_wording: Order-sensitive path dependence is an open hypothesis.
entries.prohibited_inference: Path dependence, hysteresis, causality, or a memristor has been observed.
entries.closure_obligation: Control timestamps, drift, carryover, history multiset, reset, and uncertainty.

entries.statement: A cyclic steering schedule may produce a qualified loop statistic beyond delay, drift, saturation, memoryless, and shuffle controls.
entries.allowed_wording: Reversal-loop behavior is an open controlled hypothesis.
entries.prohibited_inference: A loop exists or proves physical/electrical hysteresis.
entries.closure_obligation: Repeat cycles, counterbalance orientation, bind interpolation, and replicate.

entries.prohibited_inference: A resettable memory implementation exists.
